gaps.quote: take $f,g$ with coefficients $2^{-p}$ times Gaussian integers of modulus at most 1
gaps.note: Wrong scale. The coefficients are 2^{-p} times Gaussian integers of modulus at most 2^p (so the coefficients themselves have modulus at most 1). With modulus at most 1 inside, the integers a,b,c,e would be bounded by 1, contradicting the later bound 2^p and the final claim of modulus at most 2^p for input coefficients. Paper line 3237-3240 and 3340 state modulus at most 2^p.

gaps.note: The page never says Z equals h(B_0) = sum of h_j B_0^j for the corresponding product polynomial h, nor that h is padded with h_{2r-1}=0 so the sum over j<2r and the separation bound cover every block. The congruence q_j+rho_j = h_j mod B_0 depends on this identity, which the paper states at lines 3286-3289 and 3316-3321.

The page never describes the output being computed (truncation of H_j/2^{p+ell} to a p-bit grid) or why that gives this error, though it counts truncation in the cost. The role of the cited result is not stated, so the reader cannot tell what is returned or why the error is sqrt2 * 2^{-p}. Paper lines 3229-3231 and 3352-3361.
